Description: Availability feed is stale, allowing occupied spaces to appear open.
Response strategy: Validate timestamps before booking; hide stale spaces and notify affected drivers.

Description: Concurrent requests create a double booking.
Response strategy: Use transactions and constraints; cancel the duplicate and refund if needed.

Description: A mapping, payment, or notification API fails or changes.
Owner: Mapping Team / Payment Integration Team / Backend/API Team
Response strategy: Test contracts, monitor failures, and use retries; show addresses, pause checkout, or retain in-app status.

Description: Weak authentication or role controls expose customer or administrative data.
Response strategy: Apply least privilege, encryption, password hashing, and authorization tests; contain and disable affected access.

Description: Notification service failure causes missed confirmations, reminders, or alerts.
Response strategy: Test providers and preferences; monitor failures, retry approved notices, and show in-app status.

Description: The platform misses performance, refresh, or availability targets.
Owner: QA & Test Team / DevOps & Security Team
Response strategy: Load-test and monitor targets; prioritize booking/payment flows and remediate the limiting service.

Description: Accessibility or browser defects block core customer or admin workflows.
Response strategy: Test accessibility and supported browsers each cycle; fix blocking defects and rerun regression tests.

Description: Unprioritized requirements exceed the semester timeline.
Response strategy: Baseline the SRS and assess changes; defer lower-priority work with approval.

Description: Late API credentials or parking data block integration and testing.
Response strategy: Request access early; track dependencies and use labeled mocks or sandboxes when needed.
Agree on contracts and test integration early; prioritize the end-to-end flow.

Description: Earlier work consumes the testing buffer, leaving critical defects.
Response strategy: Test each milestone; fix critical defects first and reduce optional scope if needed.

Description: API or cloud use costs more than planned.
Response strategy: Estimate usage and review quotas; revise estimates and reduce excess use.

Description: Incorrect rates, fees, or billing rules create wrong charges or payouts.
Response strategy: Test totals, receipts, refunds, and reconciliation; pause and correct affected billing.

Description: Unclear cancellations or fraud increase refunds and chargebacks.
Response strategy: Publish policies, retain records, and use provider controls; review disputes and adjust controls.

Description: Checkout or reservations are unavailable, losing otherwise bookable revenue.
Response strategy: Monitor paid booking flows; restore checkout first and reconcile interrupted transactions.

Description: A key contributor is unavailable, delaying dependent work.
Response strategy: Document work and assign backups; reassign work and adjust the sequence.

Description: Gaps in payment, security, or mapping skills cause rework.
Response strategy: Use training, pairing, and reviews; bring in specialist support and simplify optional features.

Description: Unshared decisions or interface changes cause duplicate work and rework.
Response strategy: Record decisions and keep Trello current; hold a coordination review when conflicts arise.

Description: Limited customer or operator review misses real workflows.
Response strategy: Schedule reviews and record feedback; use representative scenarios for unvalidated assumptions.
